OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra: API tokens 20% cheaper than GPT-6 Astra, at $8 / $40 per million input/output tokens (Techmeme, AlphaSignal, 18 Nov). OpenAI also claims under one-third of GPT-6 Astra's cost per task on work and science evals. Google's Gemini 4 Neon: $3 / $15 per million input/output tokens. Inference got cheaper again, which helps application startups and squeezes resellers.
